$comment: engine.roads (MOD-024) class ladder + maintenance/upgrade/roadworks parameter set, transcribed from §20 Roads & Auto-Naming and §51 Roads v2 of docs/METROPOLIS-MASTER-v2.1.md. Every tunable number here is a PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass (GR#15 — expected values come from data, never Go literals; but the values themselves are not yet balanced, only directionally correct: more lanes = more cost, wider footprint = more cells, higher rung = faster). The 11 class slugs are schema facts, NOT balance numbers: they are §51's fixed vocabulary and must match data/naming_corpus.json's categories.roadSuffixes field names for the 9 non-numbered classes (held by TestClassSlugsMatchNamingCorpus in internal/engine/roads/drift_test.go), and the two numbered classes (urban_expressway, motorway) use §20's M-/A- numbering scheme, not a place-name+suffix pairing.

naming.$comment: Vocabulary for the non-road object kinds §20 names (civic buildings, infrastructure, transit). The Kentish toponyms and road suffixes live in data/naming_corpus.json (foundation.data) and are reused here for roads and districts; these lists are the placeholder civic-type / infrastructure-type / transit-colour vocabularies §20 names by example but does not enumerate authoritatively. All are PLACEHOLDER vocabulary pending Aaron's balance pass (GR#15 — the lists are data-sourced, never Go literals; their contents are provisional).
